description: Every stationary subset of an infinite successor cardinal contains that many disjoint stationary subsets.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.ulam_disjoint.{u} {κ : Cardinal.{u}} (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
  (S : Set (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.Carrier (Order.succ κ))) (hS : IsStationary S) :
  ∃ P,
    (∀ (i : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.Carrier (Order.succ κ)), P i ⊆ S ∧ IsStationary (P i)) ∧
      Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)
